messages.text: This fix will not used ? why ? is it not make better performance ?

It is used. The label 'finished (nothing to land)' is wrong for this row; it already landed.

- The fix (st6-rb2) landed on main as 9d7f9cb and is in the best build since 11:49Z.
- It restyles only the section whose animations pause or start, not the whole page.
- Phone recording: the 17-23 ms whole-page layout at the section switch is gone in all 4 runs with the fix (OBSERVED).
- Not yet timed on the phone as a whole stack; it was accepted by mechanism and pixels.
- The same wrong label sits on other finished rows. The lead's label fix (T-124) is meant to remove this wording.

What you need to do: nothing.
I means this label is invalid ?

Yes, for this row the label is invalid. The fix landed (9d7f9cb) and is in the best build, so 'finished (nothing to land)' is wrong.

- The label comes from the board's 'done' state. It cannot tell a landed fix from a closed job.
- The toolsmith's new labels (about 30-40 min) fix this: a done row will say 'in best build' or 'not used, because ...'.
- Until then, treat 'finished (nothing to land)' on a fix row as unreliable. Ask me and I check the Progress page.

What you need to do: nothing.

Yes. I did the workaround just now.

- The 4 done rows that link to a build (style-recalc, illusion-proposals, rest-script, best-stack) now carry a note with the real reason: landed and in the best build, or closed and not used, with why.
- The label 'finished (nothing to land)' still shows, because it comes from the board. The note under it tells the truth, and the new labels (30-40 min) replace it.
- The other 39 done rows are tool and review jobs with no build; the label is correct there.

What you need to do: reload the Status page and check the style-recalc row.
Lead, i think you could give more authority about they could investigate the workaround and long-term fix.

That is how this one was handled, and it is already the rule since T-134.

- Workaround: I fixed the 4 row notes myself within minutes.
- Long-term fix: I sent it to the toolsmith (ts-board) as part of the label change, with the data it needs.
- The desk can now do both without waiting for the lead: change a row note, open an incident, and dispatch a small tool fix to a running toolsmith.
- It still goes to the lead for decisions: priorities, landing, spawning, and anything over about 30 min of agent time.

What you need to do: nothing.

**Done: whoever owns your thread now does both the workaround and the long-term fix, without asking me.**

- **Workaround now:** fixed right away and told to you in the thread, like the desk did here with the row notes.
- **Long-term fix:** they find the cause, write down the fix plan, and send it straight to the tool helper that owns that tool.
- **Only to me:** a fix that needs a new agent or more than ~30 min of work.
- When the fix is live, they post in your thread.
- Here, the long-term fix is the new board labels ("in best build", "not used, because …"), being built now.
- Written down in fixes/AGENT_ROLES.md.

What you need to do: nothing.
And they could report you about the workaround for let's you know likes me.

**Yes: each workaround now also comes to me as a one-line note.**

- The line says: which thread, what was wrong, the workaround, and who owns the long-term fix.
- I only answer when I disagree, so it doesn't slow them down.
- Added to fixes/AGENT_ROLES.md.

What you need to do: nothing.

Agreed. Agents will now send me the same one-line report as the lead.

- Each line says: thread, what was wrong, the workaround, who owns the long-term fix.
- The rule is in fixes/AGENT_ROLES.md. I passed it to the v8 integrator and ts-board; the other owners get it with their next message.
- When you ask me about any problem, I answer from those lines and from the data, and tell you the workaround and the fix owner.

What you need to do: nothing.

Update: the new row labels are slower than I said. The code is done, but it cannot be committed yet.

- The Mac is very busy (load 40-95; the test needs under 16). Two tests failed from the load alone.
- The toolsmith (ts-board) commits as soon as the load drops, then the lead lands it.
- A broken test blocked toolsmith commits earlier. That is fixed (97b3518f).
- Until then, the 4 notes I wrote are what the Status page shows for those rows.

What you need to do: nothing.

The new row labels are live on the Status and Progress pages. Reload them.

- Every row now shows one plain label read from the Progress page, for example "in best build (v7)", "done, waits for build v8", "closed, no fix" or "dropped".
- "Finished (nothing to land)" is gone. A row that disagrees with Progress shows a red "does not match".
- A parked row says why it waits and what restarts it, or shows a red "needs review".
- Both pages have one legend that explains each label.
- Checked on the live page just now: no red mismatch and no "needs review" on the rows we talked about.

What you need to do: reload the pages and tell me if any row still reads wrong.
